Hence modalTableauS5_sound holds at K's fuel while completeness does not; plan risk R7 must be settled first.

memory_candidates.title: Generic CSLib lemmas may over-require RuleApplicationSpec when only freshLocal is used
memory_candidates.detail: modalStepBranchGen_preserves_accSourcesKnown and modalExpandBranchesGen_openBranch_accSourcesKnown (BDriver.lean) each took a bundled spec : RuleApplicationSpec apply but used it ONLY via a single `rcases spec.freshLocal`. Since RuleApplicationSpec modalApplyOneS5 is mathematically false at rankStep, the bundled form permanently locked S5 out of facts it could actually have. Before concluding a generic lemma is unusable for a spec-less rule, grep its body for `spec.` -- the true dependency is often far weaker than the signature claims. FmpMeasure.lean already takes hFreshLocal raw for exactly this reason.

memory_candidates.title: S5's universal rule trivialises the truth lemma but not termination
memory_candidates.detail: extractModelS5's relation is Relation.EqvGen acc.hasEdge (arbitrary alternating chains), which looks harder than K's single raw edge or B's SymmGen. But modalApplyOneS5's T(box phi)@w arm emits T(phi)@w' at EVERY known world, so a saturated branch already carries the payload everywhere and the S5 Hintikka bridges take a bare `w' in modalKnownWorlds b` where T's/B's take a path. The only residual obligation is that EqvGen cannot escape the known-world set -- which needs accSourcesKnown AND accTargetsKnown (one per raw-edge endpoint) and must be stated as an Iff, since EqvGen's symm constructor is not dischargeable by induction from a one-directional IH.
